items.text: 1 Nerf of the Wrath of Chernobog ability, reduced damage, and increased health requirement. The ability was too strong, even killing Koschei with a single hit.
2 Fix for floating in the air on the field in the western island.
3 Fix for the missing texture of the small mushroom effect in the caves.
4 Fix for the descriptions and buffs provided by food, now everything is in place.
5 Some things are now crafted faster, for example, the crafting time for meat has been reduced from 10 seconds to 0.2 seconds.
6 Fixed a bug that constantly reported that the storage was empty, even though it wasn't.
7 The sound of opening the secret passage in the first cave has been amplified to ensure that it is not missed.
Greetings everyone,
The decision has been made to release the game tomorrow - and for many of you, that’s already today, 03.04.26!

Why the sudden change? I was planning for May 1st, but I’m releasing tomorrow. Turns out I finished everything faster than expected. But there are other reasons too - starting mid-month, there’s a wave of AAA releases, DLCs, and big titles: Atomic Heart DLC, Diablo 4 DLC, Pragmata, Heroes: Olden Era, and several others - and after that, Gothic Remake. All of this will flood the news cycle and push indie games down in Steam visibility. Streamers and content creators will be playing AAA, not indie.
At the same time, I’ve basically wrapped up the final tasks, and realized - tomorrow is Friday, it’s quiet, no major releases, Crimson Desert hype has already cooled down. It’s time.

Partially good news: the quests in the first location (around 7 hours of gameplay) are fully voiced in English. To be precise, everything has already been voiced, but only the first 7 hours have been implemented in the game so far.

The rest of the English voice-over will be released within 1–3 weeks. I originally planned to release on the 1st only because I didn’t have time to finish the English voice-over, but since that would be a very bad release window for an indie game, I sincerely ask for understanding and apologize to the Western audience for releasing slightly earlier with incomplete voice acting.

After release, I will focus entirely on localization and English voice-over. I won’t even be taking days off. Please, if you like the game, don’t postpone your purchase - I promise the voice acting is coming!
I’m grateful to everyone who supported me along this journey. And I have one last request:
We need to push this release no matter what. Otherwise, all of this will have been for nothing.

notes.title: What matters most for Steam is activity at launch

items.text: sales volume
discussions
screenshots
community engagement
playtime
concurrent players
buy the game at launch (not now - at release moment)
ask your friends, family, dogs, cats, literally anyone
even if they refund later - the goal is to push visibility
Let’s push the game up so it gets noticed. Let’s show Steam what we can do.
Play the game, keep it running even while working, upload screenshots, write posts, be active in discussions - all of this helps a lot.

If you have any connections - ask for coverage. Share the game in groups, forums, anywhere you’re active. You know I’m a developer, not a marketer. Promotion is hard for me - but that doesn’t mean the project should be forgotten.
This was not an easy journey. But I kept my word and brought the project to completion. I won’t repeat what it cost - you already understand.
The scale of this game surprises even me, considering the resources behind it. Honestly, I’m impressed myself - and I genuinely enjoy playing through it.
I hope it wasn’t all for nothing.
See you at release.

items.text: a new Bestiary with images
a few more achievements (they are already partially available)
and some additional gamepad adjustments

Added a new skill for the archer in the General section. This ability restores mana on bow hits. Warriors have skill cooldowns, mages have mana regeneration, but archers had no way to recover their combat resource - now they do.
Arrows now stack in a single slot instead of being split into stacks of 25.
Fixed a bug that allowed item duplication when the hotbar was full.

The bug where the name "Character" was shown instead of the actual name was previously fixed only for new games - now it’s fixed for old saves as well. Reminder: go into the game settings and press Apply (hopefully it works this time).
Gostomysl now actually grants +3 Wisdom.
Wild beast entrails no longer clutter the inventory.
The Iron Sides skill now correctly provides 15 armor as intended.
The Meteor scroll has been renamed to Svarog’s Wrath.
Crafting the chest-opening scroll now requires 5 Power Stones instead of 1.
Alongside bug fixing, I’ve started implementing English voice acting and achievements.

I’m continuing to improve interactions. It turned out that previously, when the camera was zoomed out, the interaction check didn’t reach far enough, which made it seem like there was no interaction. Now I’ve changed the check to originate from the character instead of the screen. You no longer need to look directly at an object - this feels better both on gamepads and keyboard/mouse. It also fixes the issue where a companion running behind you would get prioritized, causing dialogue to trigger instead of picking up an item.
Also, if the game doesn’t launch after the previous updates, you need to reinstall it.
Fixed the Memraid and several other problematic interactions.

I also implemented the intended design for the Feat difficulty. Right now, it is essentially Challenge difficulty but with limited saves. You can save in taverns, and you can also craft a Save Ration that allows you to save anywhere. If you load a Feat save on a different difficulty, you will not receive the achievement. (Not recommended for a first playthrough)

I’ll say upfront - I haven’t fully tested this, because it would take a lot of time. Play it at your own risk for now. I added a tag so I can grant the achievement later if someone completes it before achievements are implemented. Hopefully it works. In any case, the main thing is - don’t lose your save after finishing the game. Once achievements are added, you’ll need to load that save, and the achievement will be granted.

Many minor fixes. You can now choose between Dx12 and Dx11 when launching the game. If the new version doesn't launch or crashes, choose the second option, but it doesn't support upscaling and has a slightly lower FPS.
